verdict.rationale: The evidence shows React Developer Tools, which can 'identify performance problems', and React Compiler, which applies memoization automatically at build time. Neither is described as AI-powered, and neither analyzes the component tree to suggest specific rendering or reactivity optimizations to the developer. These are adjacent features, not the capability in the story, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI-powered devtools that analyze my component tree and suggest specific rendering or reactivity optimizations

citations.quote: Use React Developer Tools to inspect React components, edit props and state, and identify performance problems.
React Compiler automatically optimizes your React application at build time
